direction.concept: The same succession of moments produces different distances traveled.
direction.substantive_non_glyph_visual: Two large, equal-sized moving disk forms leave the same number of retained positions from a shared origin. One progression remains tightly overlapping near the origin; the other separates into widely spaced positions and travels far across the field. These two finite progressions are the dominant graphic bodies, with their origin and unequal reach visible; do not turn them into an all-over dot pattern, fine diagram or tiny speed icons.
direction.expression_system: Flat, sharply bounded graphic overprinting: overlapping solid shapes accumulate density in the slower progression while the faster progression opens clear intervals. Keep the position-retention rule consistent. Large, sturdy Hangul supplies a stable graphic mass, with open counters and whole-word grouping rather than distorted or repeated letters.
direction.copy_visual_relationship: The single title group establishes the shared starting edge from which the unequal progressions depart. Its width and alignment give the viewer a reference for the two very different reaches. The slow sequence gathers near this title mass while the fast sequence pulls toward a distant crop; the maker determines the actual orientation and line breaks within that relation.
direction.distinction: M2 compares independent translations through repeated positions in an open field, with type as an origin. M3 shows physically coupled angular motion around two centers and places type in relation to the mesh. Do not introduce wheels, tooth contact or radial balance into M2.

common_constraints: Print the supplied title exactly once, with intact readable Hangul and the original word spacing. Line breaks may occur between whole words. The directions are internal guidance and must not be printed.
No other copy, supporting text, labels, numbers, logos, series identifiers, style names or watermarks. Depicted clothing, objects and surfaces must be unbranded and free of incidental text.
Each assigned maker produces only its own independent, single flat opaque poster, portrait 2:3. No panels, contact sheets, poster mockups or borrowing another maker's generated image as a reference.

The substantial non-glyph relation must remain recognizable with the title hidden and at reduced viewing size. Tiny ornament, wallpaper, background texture, gradients and 3D lettering alone do not satisfy it.

Preserve the assigned relation and distinction while solving practical crop, proportion, palette, alignment and title placement independently. There is no shared title-object-footer layout or common allocation of image and copy area.

Downstream native-tool production must request the maximum resolution supported by the current tool and model while preserving 2:3; verify the actual returned dimensions and readable copy after generation.

source_digest.case_entry_digest_method: UTF-8 canonical JSON, sorted keys, no extra whitespace

input_scope: One literal case/common input and one own role/direction; no corpus policies, peer plan or evaluation history.
